jobs.title: CHARGE DE SECURITE INFORMATIQUE
jobs.description: AVIS DE RECRUTEMENT 31-2026/HPG Le cabinet conseil et accompagnement stratégique des entreprises et organisations, HUMAN PROJECT GROUP S.A , recrute pour le compte d’une importante Institution financière basée à Ouagadougou (BF), des profils qualifiés afin de pourvoir les postes ci-après : TROIS (03) CHARGES CLIENTELES, UN(E) (01) ASSISTANT (E) DE DIRECTION, UN (E) (01) CHARGE DE SECURITE INFORMATIQUE POSTE 3 : UN (E) (01) CHARGE DE SECURITE INFORMATIQUE ( H/F) MISSIONS Le Chargé de Sécurité Informatique aura pour mission d'assurer la protection des systèmes d'information, des réseaux, des équipements et des données de l'entreprise contre les accès non autorisés, les cyberattaques, les logiciels malveillants et autres menaces informatique TACHES ET RESPONSABILITES Protection des systèmes et réseaux Mettre en œuvre les mesures de sécurité des systèmes informatiques et des réseaux ; Surveiller les équipements et infrastructures informatiques afin de détecter les activités suspectes ; Participer à la configuration et à la sécurisation des pare-feu, antivirus et autres solutions de sécurité ; Contrôler les accès aux systèmes, applications et ressources informatiques ; Veiller à la mise à jour régulière des systèmes et logiciels de sécurité. Gestion des incidents de sécurité Identifier et analyser les incidents et menaces de cybersécurité ; Participer à la gestion et à la résolution des incidents de sécurité informatique ; Mettre en place des mesures correctives et préventives ; Documenter les incidents et produire des rapports de sécurité ; Alerter la hiérarchie en cas de menace ou de faille critique. Sécurisation des données Veiller à la confidentialité, l'intégrité et la disponibilité des données ; Participer à la mise en œuvre des procédures de sauvegarde et de restauration ; Contrôler les droits d'accès aux données sensibles ; Contribuer à la protection des informations confidentielles de l'entreprise. Contrôle et prévention des risques Identifier les vulnérabilités et les risques liés aux systèmes informatiques ; Participer aux audits et contrôles de sécurité informatique ; Effectuer des contrôles réguliers des équipements et applications ; Proposer des actions permettant de réduire les risques de cyberattaques. Sensibilisation et accompagnement des utilisateurs Sensibiliser le personnel aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité informatique ; Former les utilisateurs sur les risques liés aux mots de passe, aux courriels frauduleux et au phishing ; Veiller au respect des politiques et procédures de sécurité informatique ; Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'adoption des bonnes pratiques de cybersécurité. PROFIL Être titulaire d’un BAC + 3 en Informatique et Réseaux, sécurité des Systèmes d'information, ou en sécurité des systèmes informatiques ; Avoir une expérience professionnelle confirmée d'au moins un (01) ans dans le domaine est un atout Avoir une expérience en banque sera un atout COMPETENCES TECHNIQUES Le candidat doit avoir des connaissances en : Sécurité des systèmes d'information ; Administration des réseaux et systèmes ; Sécurité des réseaux informatiques ; Pare-feu, antivirus et systèmes de détection d'intrusion ; Gestion des accès et des droits utilisateurs ; Sauvegarde et restauration des données ; Analyse des risques informatiques ; Gestion des incidents de cybersécurité ; Systèmes Windows et Linux ; Protocoles et architectures réseaux ; Outils de supervision et de surveillance de la sécurité QUALITITES ET APTITUDES PERSONNELLES Rigueur et sens de l'organisation ; Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse ; Sens élevé de la confidentialité ; Réactivité et capacité à gérer les situations d'urgence ; Esprit d'équipe ; Curiosité et veille technologique ; Capacité à résoudre les problèmes ; Sens de la responsabilité et de l'éthique professionnelle COMPOSITION DES DOSSIERS Une lettre de motivation adressée à l’Administrateur Général Adjoint de Human Project Group, datée et signée ; Un CV, détaillé, sincère, daté et signé + contacts (téléphone + adresse électronique) de trois (03) personnes de référence ; Une copie légalisée de la pièce d'identité ou du passeport ; Une copie légalisée du diplôme exigé ; Une copie des documents justifiant l'expérience professionnelle MODALITE DE RECRUTEMENT Le recrutement se fera en deux (02) phases : Une présélection sur dossier ; Un entretien avec le jury (en ligne ou en présentiel). jobs.title: People Programs Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you’ll help us achieve it 

We've built a Cross-Departmental Rotation Program, an Undergraduate Internship Program, and a growing number of Short Term Assignment (STA) and Long Term Assignments (LTA) deployments across our Opcos.

These programs exist and are working well, and now, we���re looking for someone to own them fully by re-designing, improving, and scaling them as Wave grows.

This is a role for someone who is organized and structured, but also thinks about the people's experience behind every process. You'll be the person who makes sure rotators are set up for success, interns have a meaningful experience, and employees on assignment are thriving.

What You'll Own

Rotation Program

- Run end-to-end cohort management for our Cross-Departmental Rotation Program across SN, CI, The Gambia, and new markets as we expand
- Manage the full cycle - role canvassing, applications, interviews, onboarding, monthly check-ins, evaluations, and outcomes
- Maintain scoring consistency and fairness across cohorts
- Continuously improve the program based on feedback and what the data tells you

Internship Program

- Own our Undergraduate Internship Program across Opcos - from department liaison and hiring, through onboarding, guardian management, and offboarding
- Make the intern experience genuinely great - immersive, structured, and worth their time
- Track and report on productivity impact and intern feedback

STA & LTA Deployments

- Help make assignments something people actually want - from offer alignment and benefits, to deployment logistics and check-ins
- Work with People Partners in ensuring employees on assignment are properly supported and that we're applying policies consistently across markets
- Flag gaps, edge cases or policy questions early and propose solutions

Program Design & Improvement

- Keep program guidelines current and documented
- Identify new program opportunities and own the expansion of existing programs as they grow eg; new levels, new markets, new cohort structures 
- Run design review sessions with stakeholders to stress-test program changes before they go live
- Partner with Employer Branding and Talent to amplify programs

What We're Looking For

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in a HRBP, Project Management or Recruiting role - ideally with exposure to projects or programs
- Great interpersonal skills - can engage senior leadership and understands cultural dynamics
- Clear, direct communicator - written and verbal
- Structure and follow through - you close loops and know where everything stands at any given time
- Comfortable with ambiguity - these programs will always evolve and you'll need to make judgment calls on scope and span
- Fluency in English and French is a strong requirement
- Based in one of Wave's operating markets 

Our team

- We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
- We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
- We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
- We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
- We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue .

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: HR Supervisor - French Speaking
jobs.description:
Job Description
With over two decades of experience, our team at OBT offers a long-standing tradition of shipping and logistics expertise, along with strong connections to a network of leading ship owners, operators, and local logistics specialists.

Looking for your next opportunity?

The HR Supervisor is responsible for supporting the day-to-day human resources operations in West-Africa, ensuring effective implementation of HR processes in line with Group policies and local labor regulations. The role supports recruitment, employee relations, HR administration, and employee engagement initiatives, contributing to a positive work environment and operational efficiency.

Job Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in Human Resources or HR Administration.
- Knowledge of HR best practices
- Experience maintaining employee records and HR systems (HiBob experience is an advantage).
- Experience handling recruitment and onboarding processes.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information.
- Good organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Proficiency in MS Office Applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
- Experience working in an international or multicultural environment is an advantage.

Job Responsibilities

- Serve as the main point of contact for employee HR-related queries and support requests.
- Coordinate HR-related tasks with Group HR and ensure compliance with Group policies.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR documentation in HR systems (HiBob).
- Support employee relations activities, including documenting disciplinary actions and performance processes.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer
jobs.description:
Our vision

Every B2C brand in the world is drowning in scattered tools, missed messages, and manual work. We're building the one system that runs it all — every conversation, every channel, every lead, powered by AI. Base360 is on a mission to become the operating system that B2C brands everywhere run their business on. We're early, we're moving fast, and we're looking for people who want to help build something huge from the ground up.

About The Role

We're looking for Growth Marketers to help Base360 reach the B2C brands who need us — and turn attention into signups, leads, and customers. We're channel-agnostic about how you do it: you might go deep and own a single channel, or stay broad and run across several. Paid ads, SEO, outbound, content, lifecycle, funnels — wherever your instincts pull you, we want people who can find what works and make it grow.

This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial role. You won't be one cog in a giant machine — you'll be trusted to experiment, learn fast, and build the growth engine as you go.

What You'll Do

- Own a growth channel end to end — or run across several — setting the strategy, running the campaigns, and answering for the results.
- Generate leads and drive signups — build and run the motions that fill the pipeline, from paid and SEO to outbound and referral.
- Run experiments fast — test hooks, audiences, funnels, and offers; kill what doesn't work and scale what does.
- Use AI everywhere it gives you an edge — for research, copy, targeting, automation, and speed.
- Build funnels and landing pages that convert, and obsess over the numbers behind every step.
- Work closely with the founder on positioning, messaging, and where to point the growth firepower next.
- Track everything — you live in the data and can tell a clear story about what's working and why.

Who You Are

- You're a fast learner above all — you may specialise in one growth channel or be a generalist across many, but either way you pick up new skills quickly and love figuring things out.
- You're hungry to get great at growth — you don't need to be an expert yet, but you're determined to become one of the best.
- You're AI-savvy and use modern tools to work faster and smarter than a traditional marketer.
- You're scrappy and self-directed — you take a goal and figure out the how, without waiting to be told.
- You're analytical — comfortable with data, attribution, and turning insight into action.
- Bonus: any hands-on experience with paid, SEO, outbound, content, lifecycle, or marketing to B2C brands and startups.

Why Join Base360.ai?

- Be part of an innovative and fast-growing company building the AI operating system for B2C brands.
- Opportunity to build a team and establish a long-term presence in one of Europe's most vibrant cities.
- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
- A chance to grow professionally in a hands-on, entrepreneurial role.

You Should NOT Apply If

- You are looking for a corporate 9 to 5 job.
- You are political and enjoy gossiping and talking about people behind their backs.
- You are looking for a stable and slow dead-end job.
- You do not aim to be one of the best in the world at what you do.
